_comment: Mode fulldev_eval_d19_v3w_s2of2: SHARD 2 of 2 of the full-DEV score of D19 (job-fi5xf art-p3gpi best step 2800, joint_record head, readout v3w UNTEMPERED = the screen's readout and arm: jobs.m2_first_cell.screen score and fulldev_eval score --readout v3w both call fulldev_eval.load_child(temperature=False, readout=(jrt-rwkv-g1-v3w, g1v2)); D19's own template IS v3w, so readout_spec says native=True, max_input_tokens 65536). Mirrors fulldev_eval_d13_v3w_s1of2 / _s2of2 (stack/rwkv7/d13-fulldev @a66fab1) with only the checkpoint, the cell config, the lineage data (D19's context) and the measured rate changed. Rows = shard 2 of jobs/m2_first_cell/fulldev_shards_2.json (the SAME pre-declared plan as D13: harness.cases case clusters never split, sha256(seed:case_id) mod 2, token-balanced; ids_sha256 f523934e7b85a32317b4d59e55bfdc39dbd9de338ac90c9c440234ab2c51202c, 5995 rows, 4282 clusters, 11,315,892 v1 tokens); the job rebuilds the plan from its DEV rows and exits 10 on any difference. Expected: 11,315,892 x 0.9004 x 1.2094 s/1k (job-fi5xf screen: 644 proxy600 rows, 1,613.35 s) = 205.4 min scoring + 33 fixed (load + bschema-draw-v3b lineage; job-fi5xf's screen phase measured 21.6 = 48.50 - 26.89 scoring; D13's 33 kept) + the plan pass on this shard's rows only (42 x 0.5000 = 21.0) = 259.4 min; fulldev cap 336 = 29.5 % headroom (the guard stops past 0.95 x cap: it tolerates a box 29.1 % slower). max_duration 370 (setup 12 / guard 3 / checkpoint 7 / fulldev 336 / report 5 / reserve 7): quoted hold $23.31, worst case $39.6 (cap $60). On ANY exit the partial rows ($CK/fulldev/child.partial.jsonl + identity) are copied into the phase export; a follow-up job resumes them via env SEED_PARTIAL_URL + SEED_PARTIAL_SHA256 (identity-checked). Land: fulldev_eval merge <s1 fulldev dir> <s2 fulldev dir> --out <dir>/fulldev/child.results.jsonl, then analysis/land_fulldev.py --art <dir>.
